summary: Streaming session abruptly drops final payload after cellular IP handoff (silent tail / missing end event)
description: Customer DocuBox reports repeated occurrences where SSE streams (and websocket fallback) return the expected streamed tokens but the final 'end' event or closing JSON object is never delivered following cellular network handoff (e.g., carrier change / multipath IP migration). Symptoms: client sees last few sentences missing, stream ends with a keepalive heartbeat and then connection resets without end marker. Affects production traffic from a small subset of enterprise users behind a corporate mobile VPN. Impact: customers see truncated responses in UI; some transcripts are invalid JSON causing client-side parsing failures.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use mobile client behind corporate VPN (DocuBox test device)
2) Start SSE stream for a long-form generation (>1200 tokens) targeting redwood/gptx-1.2-large in us-east production
3) Trigger a network handoff: disable cellular data briefly then re-enable to force IP path migration (or toggle mobile carrier)
4) Observe stream: keepalive heartbeats continue but final 'event: end' or final JSON terminator is not delivered; client eventually times out or receives TCP FIN without trailing payload
logs: 2026-03-09T18:12:03.452Z proxy[conn-0x7f].WARN path-migrate: detected socket migration, switching outbound path to 10.2.0.34
2026-03-09T18:12:03.457Z proxy[conn-0x7f].INFO upstream-tunnel: rebind succeeded; ingesting buffered chunks
2026-03-09T18:12:05.002Z gateway[req-0x9a].DEBUG sse: sent chunk id=4532 bytes=512
2026-03-09T18:12:10.867Z proxy[conn-0x7f].ERROR upstream: connection reset by peer during graceful-close; no end-event emitted
investigation: Support reproduced on internal staging by simulating multipath IP migration via iptables NAT rewrite. Early hypothesis was idle-probe / proxy keepalive interaction dropping FIN payloads during rebind. Captured packets show that after the migration the client-side TCP FIN arrives without the last buffered SSE frame; proxy logs indicate it believes it delivered the frame but the downstream path experienced RST during short rebind window. We also observed kv-cache session being partially primed and then not flushed on failover, resulting in the server sending 'end' as a short control frame which the proxy coalesced and the downstream lost. Correlated with proxy version 1.8.2 and an ALB idle-timeout of 60s. Repro rate ~6/10 under forced migration on test device; production sample rate ~0.2% of long streams for DocuBox users behind mobile VPN.
resolution: Workaround provided to customer: (A) enable client-side explicit session pinning header (X-Session-Pin) so proxy rebind uses same session id; (B) increase client reconnect grace-period to allow re-synchronization rather than cutting stream; (C) temporary rule: set ALB idle-timeout to 120s for DocuBox VPC. Engineering fix: patch in streaming-proxy (PR #9123) to 'flush-and-confirm' final control frames before closing on path migration and to avoid coalescing single-byte control frames with keepalive heartbeats. Patch rolled to canary and then to us-east cluster 2026-03-12 06:00 UTC. Follow-up: add integration test that simulates IP handoff, update runbook with steps to toggle ALB idle-timeout and guidance for enterprise mobile VPN customers.
